title: Clarification of what you mean by dual-licensed.
body:
Dual licensed can mean either take your pick, or that both licenses apply simultaneously.

I'd be grateful if you could clarify which is meant. Either or both are fine. Apache is mostly harmless. But MIT is completely harmless.
author: rerdavies

comments.body: You can take your pick. I'll add a clarification to the readme.
